title: Comprehensive integration of single-cell and bulk transcriptome to reveal plasma cell heterogeneity and a prognosis signature in head and neck squamous cell carcinoma.
authors: Yang, Jinyu; Wu, Wangxi; Liu, Jianwei; Li, Jing; Zhang, Feng
one_liner_zh: 该研究整合单细胞与空间转录组分析头颈鳞癌中浆细胞异质性并构建预后模型，虽涉及转录因子活性但核心为肿瘤预后生物标志物，无蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Head and neck squamous cell carcinoma (HNSCC) is a prevalent malignancy with a low five-year survival rate, emphasising the urgent need for effective prognostic biomarkers to guide patient stratification and personalised treatment. Plasma cells (PCs), a subset of antitumor effector B cells, are known for their antibody production to target tumour-associated antigens. However, their role in HNSCC remains insufficiently characterised. In this study, we integrated single-cell RNA sequencing and spatial transcriptomic datasets to investigate PC heterogeneity in HNSCC. Using the Scissor algorithm, we identified IgA(+) PCs as a key prognostic protective factor. Comparative analyses of IgA(+) and IgG(+) PCs revealed differences in pathway activity, cell communication, and transcription factor activity. Pseudotime trajectory analysis further underscored the role of the IGKV gene family in regulating PC functions related to prognosis. Additionally, a robust prognostic model leveraging IgA(+) PC-associated genes was developed using multiple machine-learning methods. This model demonstrated superior predictive performance compared to 26 existing models across TCGA-HNSC, GSE65858, GSE41613, and GSE27020 cohorts. Stratification analysis revealed significant differences between high-risk and low-risk groups in survival outcomes, pathway activity, cell infiltration, and therapeutic sensitivity. In conclusion, our comprehensive investigation reveals the critical role of IgA(+) PCs in HNSCC progression and proposes a PC-based prognostic model for patient stratification and personalised treatment, offering valuable insights into PC heterogeneity and potential therapeutic targets.
abstract_zh: 头颈部鳞状细胞癌（HNSCC）是一种常见的恶性肿瘤，五年生存率较低，亟需有效的预后生物标志物以指导患者分层和个体化治疗。浆细胞（PCs）作为抗肿瘤效应B细胞的一个亚群，以其产生抗体靶向肿瘤相关抗原的能力而闻名。然而，其在HNSCC中的作用尚未得到充分表征。在本研究中，我们整合了单细胞RNA测序和空间转录组数据集，以探究HNSCC中PC的异质性。利用Scissor算法，我们鉴定出IgA(+) PCs为关键的预后保护因素。对IgA(+)和IgG(+) PCs的比较分析揭示了它们在通路活性、细胞通讯和转录因子活性方面的差异。伪时间轨迹分析进一步强调了IGKV基因家族在调节与预后相关的PC功能中的作用。此外，利用多种机器学习方法，我们构建了一个基于IgA(+) PC相关基因的稳健预后模型。该模型在TCGA-HNSC、GSE65858、GSE41613和GSE27020队列中表现出优于26个现有模型的预测性能。分层分析显示，高风险组和低风险组在生存结果、通路活性、细胞浸润和治疗敏感性方面存在显著差异。总之，我们的综合研究揭示了IgA(+) PCs在HNSCC进展中的关键作用，并提出了一种基于PC的预后模型用于患者分层和个体化治疗，为PC异质性和潜在治疗靶点提供了宝贵见解。
